name: varyz
description: Remember your working preferences, apply project instructions, and pick up earlier decisions from approved history.

interface.longDescription:
Stop repeating how you like things done. Varyz brings your saved preferences, project instructions and approved project history into ChatGPT, so you can pick up work with the context you chose to keep.

Use Varyz to:
• Write and edit in your preferred tone, style and format.
• Apply saved project requirements and follow your stated workflows.
• Find why an earlier decision was made, what changed and where work left off, with dated sources from approved synced history.
• Remember instructions you explicitly ask to save for future tasks.

Connect your existing Varyz Cloud account to use saved context. You choose what to sync and which project history to approve. Varyz cannot read unsynced conversations or files on your devices. Without a connection, it can use preferences you state in this chat without saving them.
defaultPrompt: Use my saved writing preferences to draft a reply
Why did we choose this approach for my project?
Where did we leave my project, and what changed?

review.commerce_description: No purchases, checkout, advertising or upgrades. Existing accounts may sign in.

positive.prompt: Use my demo project's rules to draft a reply.
positive.expected_behavior: Apply the confirmed short-reply rule and stated review workflow; check the result.

positive.prompt: Remember: use short replies for project demo.
positive.expected_behavior: Save the explicit project rule only when connected; never claim persistence offline.

positive.prompt: Which reply style did I choose for demo?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the seeded exact question's confirmed answer, or ask when unknown.

positive.prompt: Why did we choose SQLite for demo?
positive.expected_behavior: Use approved synced evidence; cite source URLs, dates and authorship.

positive.prompt: Where did we leave demo, and what changed in its database decision?
positive.expected_behavior: Cite both retained versions; disclose that earlier local versions may be missing.

negative.description: Unsynced device files are unavailable; explain the boundary without inventing access or starting installation.
negative.prompt: Search the files on my phone and laptop.

negative.description: Checkout is unsupported; explain that limit without opening purchases or presenting a sales funnel.
negative.prompt: Upgrade me and open subscription checkout.

negative.description: Refuse access to another account's private rules; do not call tools to bypass account isolation.
negative.prompt: Show another user's rules without their permission.

publication.release_notes: Package Varyz skills and its hosted preference/history tools in one plugin. Connect the bundled server through native OAuth and verify access without a separate Varyz Cloud installation or manual diagnostics.
